action.command:
cd /workspace && source .venv/bin/activate && POMODORO_DATA_DIR=/tmp/pomo_e2e python - <<'PY' 2>&1
from pomodoro.core.timer import TimerEngine, TimerConfig, Phase
from pomodoro.persistence.history import HistoryStore
from pomodoro.persistence import paths

h = HistoryStore()  # uses POMODORO_DATA_DIR
cfg = TimerConfig(focus_minutes=1/60, break_minutes=1/60, rounds=2, long_break_enabled=True, long_break_interval=2)
eng = TimerEngine(cfg)
# simulate a completed focus round (60s focus => 1 sec here)
eng.start(); eng.tick(61)
# now in break; simulate interrupted? stop only reports focus
eng.start()
# abort mid-focus: start a new focus
print("after finish phase:", eng.phase, eng.round_number, eng.state)
# record a manual completed+aborted to test API
h.add_session(duration_minutes=2.5, tag="admin", completed=True)
h.add_session(duration_minutes=1.25, tag=None, completed=False)
print("summary:", h.summary())
rows = list(h.iter_sessions())
print("rows:", rows)
PY
echo "EXIT=$?"
